outcome: Maternal outcomes (gestational hypertension, proteinuria, pre-eclampsia, gestational diabetes, postpartum hemorrhage)
Fetal outcomes (preterm birth, low birth weight)
cohort: 970 female kidney donors (1332 pregnancies in the pre-donation group and 48 pregnancies in the post-donation group) at a tertiary renal transplant center in Northern India
finding: While the study found no significant risk to maternal outcomes after kidney donation, there was an increased risk of preterm birth and low birth weight among the post-donation pregnancy group.
